history.summary: A 2357 sqft '3BR' at Nin Residence for $3.1M / $1315 PSF — the low PSF is a function of an oversized unit (likely dual-key or with large balcony/PES), not genuine cheapness, and the $3.1M absolute price sits well above the liquid band where the buyer pool thins sharply. Strong 5.7%/yr appreciation and Potong Pasir MRT proximity are positives, but the size/price combination is the dominant risk.
history.rating_rationale: 2357 sqft for a 3BR is anomalously large (oversized_unit pattern) — the $1315 PSF looks cheap only because it's spread over an unusually big footprint; $3.1M absolute is the real constraint and lands above the $2.5M liquidity ceiling. URA median is $1729 so the PSF discount is partly the size effect. Appreciation 5.7%/yr (67 txn) and 330m to Potong Pasir MRT are genuinely good, balancing the exit-risk concern to Neutral.
red_flags: Oversized 2357 sqft for a 3BR — low PSF is a size artefact, not value
$3.1M absolute price above the liquid buyer-pool band
67 txn is moderate; size makes this unit type harder to comp/resell
catalysts: 330m to NE10 Potong Pasir MRT (NEL, direct to CBD)
City-fringe D13 location with stable demand

history.summary: Well-located D13 (RCR) 2BR three minutes from Potong Pasir MRT, asking $1,630 psf in line with verified recent transactions, with the deepest and most credible value signal of this batch.
history.rating_rationale: This is the standout on data quality: 67 appreciation txns and 11 cohort comps (vs 1-3 for the boutiques here), so the -13.4% age-adj-cheap and -6.1% cohort discount are statistically credible rather than artifacts. Asking $1,630 psf sits right around the 12-month average ($1,617, range $1,262-1,823) - confirmed cheap-but-real, not a mis-scrape. Per v3.4 priors, verified cheap-vs-district peers is the strongest forward signal, and D13 sits in the RCR band (realized forward ~+3.5%, well above CCR). Trailing +5.75% CAGR is a positive story (though discounted as forward proof). Three-minute walk to Potong Pasir NE10 with Woodleigh NE11 nearby, a 219-unit project (adequate liquidity), and a ~1,012sf efficient 2BR. The single-block high-density layout is a minor negative but doesn't offset a robust value + location case.
red_flags: Single 19-storey block with 219 units = higher density / less exclusivity
99-yr leasehold from 2014 - lease decay clock running (though ~88 yrs left, immaterial near-term)
Asking is at-market (~$1,630 vs avg $1,617), so the discount is to district peers, not to the project's own recent comps
catalysts: 3-minute walk to Potong Pasir MRT (NE10), Woodleigh (NE11) nearby - strong transit
RCR location (D13) with above-CCR realized forward returns
Bidadari estate maturation and Woodleigh Mall/transport-hub upgrades support area demand
Deep, credible value discount vs district peers (-13.4% age-adj on 67 txns)
